results.question: What functions do the Supertrees at Gardens by the Bay serve?

response.markdown:
### Knowledge Base

_Dated source excerpts; descriptions of exhibitions, prices and hours are not verified current information._

- The Supertrees support vertical planting. [Gardens by the Bay Singapore | Sky Garden & Light Show](https://www.visitsingapore.com/neighbourhood/featured-neighbourhood/marina-bay/gardens-by-the-bay/)

- Their functions include harvesting rainwater, producing solar energy and ventilating conservatories. [Gardens by the Bay Singapore | Sky Garden & Light Show](https://www.visitsingapore.com/neighbourhood/featured-neighbourhood/marina-bay/gardens-by-the-bay/)

- Super trees tower over the rest of the gardens, built to mimic real-life trees using technology such as solar cells. [Singapore/Marina Bay – Travel guide at Wikivoyage](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Singapore/Marina_Bay)

results.question: What art does National Gallery Singapore collect?

response.markdown:

_Dated source excerpts; descriptions of exhibitions, prices and hours are not verified current information._
